title: Plum and Almond Cream Tart
changes_from_base: Overlapping rings of fresh plum on almond cream in a soft vanilla crust, instead of poached pears.
summary: A soft vanilla crust filled with almond cream and covered with tight rings of fresh plum wedges.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt
plain flour, plus plenty for rolling
fine sea salt or table salt
small dark plums, stoned and cut into 6 mm wedges

steps.title: Crust
steps.text: beat the butter, icing sugar, salt and vanilla on low for 1 min, then on medium for 1 min. Add the egg, then the flour, and mix until smooth. Wrap and chill about 1 h, until firm.

steps.title: Almond cream
steps.text: grind the almonds with the flour to a coarse meal. Beat the butter, icing sugar and salt as for the crust, add the egg and yolk and beat about 2 min, then mix in the almond meal just until combined.

steps.title: Line
steps.text: let the dough sit 10 min, knead it briefly and roll it on a well-floured surface to 32 cm. Lift it into the tin, trim, and freeze until hard. This dough is soft; keep it cold and work quickly.

steps.title: Blind bake
steps.text: heat the oven to 180 °C (160 °C fan). Bake on the tray with paper and beans for 12-15 min, until the edges just colour, then 5 min uncovered. Cool.

steps.title: Arrange
steps.text: spread the almond cream over the base. Lay the plum wedges in an overlapping ring at the edge, reverse direction for the next ring and fill the middle.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: sprinkle with demerara and bake 30-40 min, until the almond cream is puffed and golden and the plums are soft. The plums sink a little into the almond cream as it puffs.

tips: Small dark plums give the most colour.
A 23 cm tin works; use any extra plums and almond cream in a few ramekins.
Patch any cracks in the case with scraps before baking.
Don't taste the raw dough or batter: raw flour and raw egg aren't safe to eat until baked.
storage: Keep covered at room temperature for 1 day, or in the fridge for up to 3 days.
